entries.claim: The presence check inspects every raw `--event` occurrence rather than the effective event that `planning.mjs` dispatches with.
entries.failure_scenario: `trace append ... --event gate_pass --event rearm` is rejected because the loop finds the first `gate_pass` and demands a figure, even though `parseArgs` retains the last event and the handler will append a `rearm` receipt. Thus a `rearm` invocation that carries no figures is newly refused merely because an earlier, overridden duplicate event was supplied, contradicting the requirement that `rearm` remain unconstrained.
